name: Harley-Davidson Sportster 883 (1986-2003)
engine: 883 cc air-cooled Evolution V-twin, one carb, rigid-mounted engine
intro: The solid-mount Evo Sportster. One carb, lots of vibration and a simple bike to learn on.

B: A rigid-mounted engine shakes things loose. Check every fastener, mount and light bracket.

recallNote: Harley-Davidson has issued several recalls that touch these years. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls before you start.
